CustomField.inlineHelpText: Does the response clearly outline the investigation undertaken & explain why the investigation supports the outcome provided? Has a chronology &/or supporting material been included/attached where relevant? Does the response give the customer the information that ANZ relied on to reach the decision? The response should detail what enquiries were made (& with whom) and how those enquiries support the outcome reached. Is any chronology included clear and sequential? Are there any gaps in the chronology?
CustomField.label: Response has investigation info & reason
